changed: A group row no longer shows a count or worn/consumable marks of its own, unless it carries a weight or calories.
Naming a group no longer offers catalog or My Gear suggestions. A group is a heading you write.
fixed: A weight typed into a group's name, like "Cook kit 540 g", is no longer added to the group; only the name is.
A row whose only entry is its calories is no longer discarded when you click away from it.
